class Account:
    def __init__(self, balance):
        self.__balance = balance # __ makes it private
    def deposit(self, amount):
        if amount > 0:
            self.__balance += amount
    def get_balance(self):
        return self.__balance
a = Account(1000)
a.deposit(500)
print(a.get_balance()) # 1500
# print(a.__balance) -> AttributeError
Note: Double underscore triggers name mangling. It hides data but is not true security.
